frequency_question: What proportion of Senate-confirmed executive nominees successfully clear the recorded floor vote criteria within the strict time boundary without technical failure modes?
membership_rule: Includes all formally submitted principal officer nominations reaching the Senate floor. Excludes positions not requiring Senate confirmation or nominations withdrawn prior to committee consideration.
coverage_note: 6 named representative cases spanning recent administrations; broader historical base rate for successful floor votes conditional on reaching the floor is roughly 85-90%.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list every minor agency nomination, focusing instead on high-profile principal officer equivalents.
skeleton: Total recorded floor confirmation votes for high-profile executive nominees divided by total formal nominations reaching final floor consideration stages.
multiplier: 5 hits / 6 total documented major nomination resolution pathways = 83.3%
validity_reason: Remains stable through the current congressional structural norms regarding confirmation votes.
